description: Client-side utility functions for handling party details, addresses, taxes, and contact info in ERPNext.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_party_details
methods.description: Fetches and updates party details based on form data, with support for different doctype types.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.add_item
methods.description: Automatically adds an item to a new form if navigated from an item route.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_address_display
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the address in a formatted manner based on address fields.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.set_taxes_from_address
methods.description: Sets tax category based on address details and updates taxes accordingly.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.set_taxes
methods.description: Calculates and sets taxes based on party and address details.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_contact_details
methods.description: Fetches contact details for a selected contact person.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.validate_mandatory
methods.description: Validates that a mandatory field has a value, throws error if not.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_shipping_address
methods.description: Retrieves shipping address details for the selected company.
